# FakeSQL - fake user data generated by SQL stored routines

A "Faker" implemented as PostgreSQL stored routines (schema `fk`) plus a small web app (Python/FastAPI).
Pick a locale (English/USA, German/Germany) and a seed, get batches of fake users:
name, address, uniformly distributed geolocation, height/weight (normal distribution), eye colour, phone, e-mail.
The same locale + seed + batch always returns the same users.

* Full documentation of every routine and algorithm: [DOCUMENTATION.md](DOCUMENTATION.md) (also served by the app at `/docs`)
* Install the database: `pip install "psycopg[binary]"` then `python tools/install_db.py "<postgres url>"`
* Run the app: `cd app && DATABASE_URL="<postgres url>" uvicorn main:app`
* Speed test: `DATABASE_URL="<postgres url>" python tools/benchmark.py`
* Statistical checks: `psql "<postgres url>" -f tools/validate.sql`

Layout: `db/` SQL (schema, random numbers, helpers, generators, lookup data), `app/` web app, `tools/` install/benchmark/validate/data loader.
